interface.title: CAFE – Cell Analyzer for Flow Experiment (Streamlit multipage app)
interface.field: Immunology / spectral flow cytometry (high-dimensional single-cell analysis)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis after gating: combine samples, run QC, check and correct batch effects, reduce dimensions, cluster, annotate, compare groups and export
interface.what_it_is_for: Turning gated, scaled per-sample CSV exports from a spectral flow cytometer into a combined AnnData object with QC, batch correction, PCA, UMAP and Leiden clusters, then merging and annotating clusters into cell types and exporting figures, tables and .h5ad files.

data.note: I uploaded HD01_Control.csv, HD02_Control.csv, PT01_Treated.csv and PT02_Treated.csv together. CAFE read them as 4 samples in 2 groups (Control, Treated), 40 cells and 12 shared markers (CCR5, CD11c, CD127, CD141, CD16, CD1c, CD27, CD38, CD4, CD45ra, CD56, HLA-DR). Rows with missing values were dropped, leaving 39 cells, and QC kept 38. With so few cells, every result is a toy result. No matplotlib figure loaded anywhere in the app: each one showed as a broken image labelled '0'. So plots never appeared; only tables and text did.

features.name: Outlier-filter preview with threshold sensitivity table
features.general: Choose a robust outlier threshold globally or per group, see a live preview of how many items each group would lose plus a sensitivity sweep over nearby thresholds, adjust single groups if needed, then commit the filter and get a per-group removal report
features.specific: QC step: radio None / Perform QC / Perform QC per sample; Number of MADs slider (global) or Target % removed per tail plus a 'Fine-tune per sample' n_MADs spinbox for each sample; preview table (median, MAD, lower/upper cut, % removed); sensitivity table (% removed at n_MADs 2–8); Apply QC gives a 'Cells removed per sample' table
steps: Pick the QC mode (none, global, per sample)
Set n_MADs with the slider, or set a target % per tail
Optionally override n_MADs for individual samples
Read the preview and sensitivity tables
Press Apply QC and read the per-sample removal summary
serves_tasks: Preview how many events each threshold would remove, then apply the filter

features.name: Batch assignment table with batch-effect diagnosis and before/after correction
features.general: Assign each sample to a technical batch in an editable table, score each measurement for how different the batches are, apply a correction, and compare the scores before and after
features.specific: Batch Correction step: editable Batch column (SampleID / Group / Batch); 'Check for batch effects' gives a per-marker EMD table (emd_max, emd_mean, worst_batch) and a verdict box ('No marker exceeds an EMD of 0.5…'); None/ComBat radio and Apply give a 'Batch effect before vs after' table (EMD before, EMD after, change)
steps: Type a batch label for each sample in the Batch column
Press Check for batch effects and read the EMD table and verdict
Choose ComBat (or None) and press Apply
Compare EMD before and after per marker
serves_tasks: Assign each sample to a technical batch
Measure how far each measurement differs between batches
Apply a batch correction and compare before and after

features.name: Dimensionality reduction with variance-threshold component selection
features.general: Choose a decomposition solver and a cumulative explained-variance cut-off; the tool keeps the components needed to reach it and reports how many it kept
features.specific: PCA step: Skip PCA / Perform PCA radio, then 'Choose the SVD solver' dropdown (Auto/Full/Arpack/Randomized) and an explained-variance slider (70–99); Apply PCA reports '3 of 11 components reach the 95% threshold' and shows PCA before/after ComBat coloured by Batch and by Group
steps: Choose Perform PCA
Pick an SVD solver
Set the variance threshold
Press Apply PCA and read the retained-component count
serves_tasks: Reduce the measurements to the main components that explain most of the variance

features.name: Graph clustering and embedding parameter panel
features.general: Set neighbour-graph, embedding and community-detection parameters in one panel, run all of them with step-by-step progress, and get a summary of the resulting groups
features.specific: UMAP + Leiden step: Leiden Resolution slider (0.01–2.50), n_neighbors slider (5–50), UMAP min_dist slider, Distance metric dropdown, Leiden flavor (igraph/leidenalg), 'Dimension reduction metric to use' (X_pca); Apply and Compute shows 'Step 1/4…' progress, then '38 cells · 4 samples · 3 Leiden clusters · PCA · ComBat correction'
steps: Set the resolution and neighbour count
Pick a distance metric and Leiden flavor
Choose which representation to cluster on
Press Apply and Compute and wait through the 4 steps
Read the cluster summary line
serves_tasks: Build a neighbour graph, embed it in 2D and cluster cells into populations

features.name: One-click results bundle
features.general: See a list of everything the archive will contain, then download the processed dataset, run parameters, per-sample tables and summary tables together in one file
features.specific: End of Data Processing: 'What's in the download' expander listing adata_*.h5ad, analysis_parameters_*.txt, per_sample_clustered CSVs, umap_plots and count/frequency/median tables; 'Download all outputs (.zip)' button
steps: Open the contents expander and read what the archive holds
Press the download button for the ZIP
serves_tasks: Download the full set of results in one archive

features.name: Cluster merge builder with live preview
features.general: Group existing category labels under new names using rows of name plus multi-select, watch chips track which labels are still unassigned, preview the mapping as a format string, then apply it and download the relabelled data
features.specific: Merge Clusters: 'N remaining · M assigned' chip bar; rows of New name + Source clusters multiselect; + Add group / Remove last; Merge preview card and Generated format string {Lymphoid:0,2}; note of which clusters pass through unchanged; Finalize Merging leads to 'Download merged data + log (merged_data_xxxx.zip)' and Start a new merge
steps: Type a new group name
Pick the source clusters in the multiselect
Optionally add more groups
Check the merge preview and format string
Press Finalize Merging and download the merged zip
serves_tasks: Combine several clusters under one new name

features.name: Marker-signature grid with probabilistic type assignment
features.general: Define each type as a row in a grid of +/− marks per measurement; the tool fits a two-component mixture per measurement and sample, scores every item against each signature, sorts items into high-confidence, ambiguous or unassigned, and reports purity per existing cluster plus per-sample gate diagnostics
features.specific: Cluster Annotation → Probabilistic (GMM): Marker signatures data editor (Cell type + one +/− dropdown column per marker), Auto-tune thresholds checkbox, Min match score / High-confidence margin / Ambiguous margin sliders, Random seed; Run probabilistic annotation gives a 'Cells per type × confidence level' table, UMAPs by type and confidence, a Per-cluster purity table, GMM gate diagnostics (cutoff, separation, informative, source per sample × marker, with Sample/Marker pickers), and 'Prepare download (full + high-conf + high&low-conf)'
steps: Type a cell type name in a new row
Set + or − on the defining markers
Keep auto-tune on, or set the three thresholds by hand
Run probabilistic annotation
Review the confidence table, purity and gate diagnostics
Prepare the download
serves_tasks: Label cells as types from a positive/negative marker signature with confidence scores

features.name: Marker-subset dataset builder
features.general: Upload raw per-sample files, keep only chosen measurements via removable chips, and build a new dataset from them, as the first of several numbered steps (later dimension-reduction and clustering steps were not reached)
features.specific: Selective Clustering: 'Subset by removing markers' or 'Subset by cell type' + Apply, 'Step 1 of 5' progress bar, CSV upload, 'Select markers to retain' chip multiselect, Submit Marker Selection gives the selected-markers list, 'Expression data shape (39, 11)', 'AnnData object created', then a PCA section (None/Perform PCA) appears
steps: Choose the subset mode and press Apply
Upload the CSVs
Remove the markers to exclude
Submit Marker Selection and read the selected-marker list and data shape
serves_tasks: Build a new dataset from a chosen subset of markers
